text:
[Kafra Employee]
Welcome to the
Kafra Corporation.
The Kafra services
are always on your side.
How may I assist you?
translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
欢迎光临卡普拉公司！
卡普拉服务永远在您身边。
您需要什么服务呢？

text:
[Kafra Employee]
Welcome. ^ff0000{0}^000000 Member.
The Kafra Coporation will stay with you wherever you go.
translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
欢迎光临，^ff0000{0}^000000的成员。
无论您去往何处，卡普拉公司都与您同在。

text:
[Kafra Employee]
I'm sorry, but you don't
have enough zeny to use
the Storage Service. Our
Storage access fee is {0} zeny.
translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
很抱歉，您的Zeny不足，无法使用仓库服务。
使用仓库需要{0} Zeny。

text:
[Tono]
The larva of Creamy is Fabre. So, those green little wormy things are actually the babies of those pinkish, purply butterfly things you see around.
translation:
[托诺]
克瑞米的幼虫是绿棉虫。在地上随处可见的那些绿色小虫子，其实是那些粉紫色蝴蝶的宝宝。

text:
[Shuger]
So if there's something on the ground that you want to pick up, be careful lest it be consumed by a Poring. Then again... Porings are pretty weak...
translation:
[舒格]
所以如果地上有你想捡的东西，小心别被波利先吞掉了。不过话说回来...波利其实很弱...

text:
[Strife]
I'll be the most
awesomest Knight around!
It's... It's my most precious dream.
translation:
[斯特莱夫]
我要成为最最厉害的骑士！
这...这是我最珍贵的梦想。
